title: Describing a Place
objectives: Use prepositions in, on, at for location.
Describe a room or town in a short paragraph.
canDo: I can describe a place combining existence, possession, and location.

warmUp.title: Descrever lugares
warmUp.prompt: Descreva sua sala de aula em português em 3 frases. Agora tente usar there is/are e have.

explanation:
Combine structures:
• There is a desk in my room. | I have a lamp on the desk.
• Prepositions: in (dentro), on (em cima), at (em/ponto), under (debaixo), next to (ao lado)

In the bedroom there is a bed. My phone is on the table. The cat is under the chair.

grammar.title: Describing Places
grammar.rule: Use there is/are for existence in a place; have/has for ownership. Add prepositions for precise location: on the wall, in the bag, at the door.

examples.sentence: There is a mirror on the wall.
She has keys in her bag.

vocabulary.example: The keys are in the bag.
The cup is on the table.
The cat is under the bed.
The bank is next to the pharmacy.
My laptop is on the desk.
There is a bed in the room.
There is a clock on the wall.
There are two cafés on my street.

sentences: There is a supermarket at the end of the street.
In my bag I have a wallet and some keys.

reading.title: My Favourite Café
reading.text: There is a small café next to my office. There are five tables inside. On the wall there are beautiful photos. The owner has a friendly dog. The dog is usually under one table. I have coffee there every morning. There isn't much noise — it is a quiet place.

questions.question: Where is the café?
questions.explanation: A small café next to my office.

questions.question: Where is the dog usually?
questions.explanation: The dog is usually under one table.

questions.question: Is the café noisy?
questions.explanation: There isn't much noise — quiet place.

writing.prompt: Describe your favourite place (8 sentences): use there is/are, have/has, and at least 3 prepositions.
writing.modelAnswer: There is a park near my house. There are many trees and a lake. On weekends I have picnics there. My friends have bikes. We sit on the grass under a big tree. There are no shops in the park, but there is a café at the entrance.

tutorHints: Draw a room plan for there is + prepositions.
